claim_boundary: This rubric may be executed only after the frozen G0-G7 evidence audit is complete. It scores the strength and completeness of the computational evidence package; it cannot guarantee acceptance, assign a journal quartile, or replace a current external novelty and journal-fit review.
preregistration_note: Frozen before completion of the first formal trajectory, the k-point comparison, any final DFT-domain label, and every formal statistical outcome.

independent_reference_and_applicability.rule: Complete numerical and domain supervisors, MPI equivalence, and a full two-domain G2 release.

transport_design_and_inference.rule: Complete five-by-five hierarchical transport and balanced five-by-three nested velocity inference.

robustness_and_sensitivity.rule: The preregistered finite-size, fixed-volume, and NPT-volume robustness gate passes without changing margins.

mechanistic_depth.rule: All 25 mechanism grids and all twelve multiplicity-controlled associations are retained; robust supported associations add evidence but a complete null result remains publishable.

experimental_relevance.rule: All nine eligible exact-composition comparisons are evaluated with scope, direct/derived role, and prediction intervals retained. Compatibility itself is an outcome, not a scoring requirement.

reproducibility_and_reporting.rule: All publication/manuscript artifacts, tests, environment checks, and clean byte-identical regeneration attestations pass.
